minor.name: Close candidate #279 is already closed on GitHub
minor.summary:
The new close_candidates entry for #279 says `gh issue view 279` reports OPEN and recommends closing it. GitHub now reports #279 CLOSED (COMPLETED, 2026-11-19T23:30:47Z), so the entry recommends an action that has already happened and the evidence line is stale. The counts block (close_candidates 37) and the entry itself would drop it on the next sync.

Also (roast): The new close_candidates entry for #279 says '`gh issue view 279` reports OPEN' and recommends closing it. GitHub shows #279 CLOSED (COMPLETED) at 2026-11-19T23:30:47Z, before both branch commits were committed at 23:33:24Z. The catalog now queues an already-closed issue for closing, and its evidence states a fact that was false when the commit was made. The #305 entry next to it is still accurate (open). The retire flow (todo-editor.md retire step 4) adds an entry only for an issue that still needs closing; the five retirements' other issues (#272, #204, #301) correctly got no entry because they were already closed. #279 should have been handled the same way.

Also (roast): The Files Changed row for RepoToDo.json says the PR 'adds the bookmarks-display slash-command item (issue 305)'. The opposite happened: that item (todo-v62t) was retired, and #305 became a close candidate. The Summary also says 'a working refs stale-override follow-up is added', but todo-yu6v was already on main and only its summary text changed. The description never names the five retired ids (todo-k69m, todo-545g, todo-ys3k, todo-v62t, todo-v8mh) or says that items dropped from 78 to 73.
fix: Remove the #279 entry from close_candidates and lower counts.close_candidates from 37 to 36.
Or keep it and reword the evidence to say the issue was closed on 2026-11-19 after PR #322.
Delete the #279 object from close_candidates (docs/TODO/RepoToDo.json:4442-4450) and drop counts.close_candidates from 37 to 36.
Or keep the entry and rewrite its evidence to say #279 was closed as completed at 2026-11-19T23:30:47Z, with recommended_action 'none; already closed'.

Update the PR body: RepoToDo.json retires todo-k69m (#301), todo-545g (#272), todo-ys3k (#204), todo-v62t (#305) and todo-v8mh (#279), leaving 73 items; it adds close candidates #305 and #279 and rewrites todo-yu6v's Related clause. Drop the 'added' claims.
